label: Sriracha
short_description: A Gulf-of-Thailand port and industrial city on the Eastern Seaboard, near Laem Chabang.
intro: Sriracha's hotels in this directory sit in a working port and industrial city on Chonburi's Eastern Seaboard, about 75-90 minutes from both Bangkok and Suvarnabhumi Airport and roughly 45 minutes from Pattaya. The city's economy runs on the adjacent Laem Chabang deep-sea port and its Japanese-expat business community rather than tourism, so hotels here skew toward business and transit stays, with Ko Si Chang island a short speedboat ride offshore for a quieter side trip.
